faq.title: Questions Before You Start
faq.description: Clear answers about setup, cost, image quality, privacy, and supported devices.

howItWorks.question: How does it work?
howItWorks.answer: Start with a photo, reference, or idea. Choose a preset or AI Mask, or open Studio and describe what you want. Before you create, the app shows the credit cost and whether a plan is required.

sourcePhotos.question: Is personal AI model training required?
sourcePhotos.answer: No. Use presets, AI Masks, Studio, and supported generation or editing models without training a personal model. Train one only when you want the same person to stay recognizable across repeated photos; this optional workflow uses 10–20 varied selfies and requires Pro or Max.

pricing.question: How much does it cost, and are there limits?
pricing.answer: One-time credits work with eligible pay-as-you-go models. US reference packs are 200 credits for $5.99 or 300 for $8.99. Pro starts at $6.99 per week and adds 2K plus optional Standard training; Max starts at $29.99 per month and adds 4K plus optional Full training. Annual plans are billed in full and add credits monthly. Final localized offers vary by country and platform, and credits never expire.

subscriptions.question: How do I manage or cancel a subscription?
subscriptions.answer: Manage Apple subscriptions in your Apple Account, Google subscriptions in Google Play, and web subscriptions from billing settings or support. Cancellation takes effect at the end of the paid period. You keep unused credits and personal AI models you already trained.

imageQuality.question: What affects image quality?
imageQuality.answer: Results depend on your source photo or reference, the preset, AI Mask, or model you choose, and your prompt. Use a clear, well-lit photo when a workflow asks for one, and compare multiple results if needed.

privacy.question: How are my photos and data handled?
privacy.answer: You choose whether generated photos are public or private. Photos stay in your account until you delete them, and you can permanently remove individual images or your full library. We do not sell your personal data.

platforms.question: Where can I use My AI Photo Shoot?
platforms.answer: Use it in a web browser or through the iOS and Android apps.

whyNotChatGPT.question: How is this different from a general AI image tool?
whyNotChatGPT.answer: My AI Photo Shoot brings guided presets, AI Masks, Studio, custom prompts, and specialized generation and editing models into one focused photo workflow.
